decisions.reason: Keep source role and invocation boundary; add Paul provenance, local MIT notice and the shared browser adapter. Bounded language, implementation and review changes are documented in the beta protocol.

Honor explicit tool choice; route research and general browsing to Aside, development verification and otherwise unspecified browser work to Playwright. Keep analysis/QA judgments separate from browser operation and require controlled evidence before changing task-class defaults.

Grouped list/select proposal is preserved in the linked report. One desktop fixture passed; native select keyboard selection at 390px did not change value. Remaining cases, including variant, were not run. Retain existing control until browser compatibility is resolved.

Resolve the earlier defer: adopt grouped side-list/native-select controls and clarify browser-owned select keyboard handling. Preserve Paul provenance, user-only invocation, shared browser routing and existing task-state/overlay checks.
